traits.name: Stalk-still
traits.text:
A myconid that remains perfectly still has advantage on
Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.

actions.name: Stone Knuckles
actions.text:
Melee weapon attack: +7 to hit. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3)
slashing damage.

actions.name: Spore Bomb
actions.text:
Ranged weapon attack: +8 to hit, range 30/60 ft. Hit: 15
(6d4) poison damage and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution
saving throw or drop to 0 hit points.
